_comment: Characters whose character totals diverge from the Java oracle for KNOWN pre-existing reasons (dominant: VariablePowerPool.real_cost_pre_list omits the pool cost). This ledger may only SHRINK. Fix the engine, remove the entry. 2026-06-07. 2026-07-24: the two HSEG computer prefabs left the ledger when the loader started honouring Java's template gate (PROGRAM is a Computer6E/AI6E talent, absent from Main6E.hdt, so Java drops it and charges nothing). 2026-08-17 (VPP): 55 entries left the ledger when the loader began reading framework <ADDER> children -- a VPP's CONTROLCOST adder carries the control cost in its LEVELS, and the framework branch had read only <MODIFIER> children, so all 93 pools costed control at 0. Remaining deltas were REFRESHED to current values in the same pass; several pools that were already overcharging now overcharge by more, which is the next thread to pull. 2026-08-17 (VPP slots): 10 more entries left when total_points stopped counting powers inside a pool -- Java's VariablePowerPool.getRealCostForChild returns a flat 0. Applied in the totals loop, NOT in real_cost_for_child: a slot's own reported cost is non-zero in the oracle dump and real_cost delegates to the parent, so zeroing the method would collapse every slot. 12 left: 4 Vehicle6E characters (engine OVER) and 8 small negatives (engine UNDER), neither VPP-related. 2026-08-17 (SIZE): 3 more left when CHARACTERISTICS became template-gated like every other section -- Java walks the template's characteristic set and pulls each out of the file (Hero.java:2472), so <SIZE> (4 corpus vehicles, absent from Main6E.hdt) is never read. The old 'characteristics must stay ungated' note was measured against the JSON dump. 9 left, ALL negative (engine under): THE_STARBIRD -26 and UNDEAD_LICH -1 are the two documented per-object residuals; the other 7 are a CHARGES-on-MULTIPOWER group where Charges.parentUsesEND() lacks Java's List branch (ask the slots, not the container). 2026-08-17 (framework slots): 7 more left when a framework began holding its own slots (List.objects was never populated -- children linked upward only) and Charges.parentUsesEND gained Java's List branch, which asks the SLOTS whether they use END because a reserve never does itself (Charges.java:450). DOWN TO 2, and both are the documented per-object residuals: THE_STARBIRD (-26, FLIGHT/CHARGES on Vehicle6E, oracle contradicts a static read of the Java) and UNDEAD_LICH (-1, DETECT sense-group deduction, HD cache/global-state). Every character-total divergence in the corpus is now one of those two. 2026-08-17 (Vehicle6E): THE_STARBIRD left when the loader stopped emulating Vehicle6E. HD costs a character against the template it has LOADED, not the one the file names, and the oracle CLI loads Main6E throughout; the emulation forced USESEND=No on movement powers, clamping a +0.25 CHARGES away. ONE entry left: UNDEAD_LICH -1. 2026-08-17 (LICH): EMPTY. The last entry left when Sense.total_cost gained the no-template gate -- HD registers sense groups during template load (SenseGroup.clear), so a character with no TEMPLATE attribute has no groups and takes no sense-group deduction. UNDEAD_LICH is the only one of 12 identically shaped corpus Detects whose file declares no template, and the only one the oracle does not deduct for. This ledger is now empty and must stay that way: every one of the 655 fixture characters matches the Java oracle on every object AND on character totals.
